pa-topic-rules.txt:
Pennsylvania policy topic coding rules from reviewed examples and guideline excerpts:
- Assign the narrowest topic matching the bill summary's substantive subject. Use the specific action and affected area; statute title alone does not control.
- Public School Code provisions concerning agreements between school districts are elementary/secondary education (602).
- Municipal and residual waste facility siting, host municipality agreements, and related moratoria concern solid/hazardous waste management (703).
- Freezing assets of criminal defendants is criminal justice procedure (1204); defining racketeering activity under Crimes and Offenses is crime and criminal code (1202).
- Unemployment compensation rates and amounts are employment compensation/policy (503), not macroeconomic unemployment (103).
- Professional licensure board appropriations and occupational licensing are professional licensing (1527).
- State procurement organization and Department of General Services duties are government procurement (2008); Commonwealth agency fee provisions specific to the Department of State are its administration (2011).
- Hospital and medical cost monitoring is health care costs (322); payment arrangements for health care service contractors are health insurance (323).
- County assessment error refunds and assessment appeals are local taxation/property assessment (2404).
- Acquired immune deficiency syndrome services under Public Welfare are public assistance/social services (331).
- Unified retirement systems for Commonwealth and political subdivision employees are public employee retirement (2004).
- Emergency service providers recognition is fire/emergency services (1209).
- Urban Growth Authority creation, grants, bonds, and indebtedness referendum are community development/economic development (1403).
- School carbon monoxide alarm standards are environmental health/safety (708).
